image_description: A low-angle, close-up view of the underside and support structure of a massive white radio telescope dish. The image highlights the complex lattice of steel trusses supporting the parabolic reflector. A white rectangular equipment box (likely housing receivers or electronics) is mounted on the central support column. The background shows a pale blue sky and hints of other structural elements.
